description: Which action classes require a human-granted approval-request before they may execute. Consumer: policy-engine.mjs requiresApproval(actionClass); ops.mjs approval commands read this to validate an action class name. The classes from rights-change to bulk-data-change are the human-in-the-loop classes of the MUSIC OS 360 operational pack: an approval of one of them must be bound to the exact payload (hash) it covers, decided by someone other than the requester, and is checked by the automation-runs-gated check of gate-engine.mjs.

actionClasses.name: production-write
examples: run a migration against a live database

actionClasses.name: external-send
examples: post to an external API with side effects

actionClasses.name: dependency-upgrade-mass
examples: updating more than 5 dependencies in one change

actionClasses.name: rights-change
actionClasses.description: Changing who holds a right, its territory or period on a Work or Phonogram
examples: assign a right to another holder
change a territory or period of a right
change a credit that states authorship or performance

actionClasses.name: share-change
actionClasses.description: Changing a share of a Work or Phonogram
examples: add, remove or edit a share row
change the participant a share belongs to

actionClasses.name: percentage-change
actionClasses.description: Changing a percentage that decides who is paid how much
examples: rebalance shares to total one hundred percent

actionClasses.name: entity-merge
actionClasses.description: Merging two entities into one definitively

actionClasses.name: deletion
actionClasses.description: Deleting a business record or document
examples: delete a Work, Phonogram, Release, contract or participant

actionClasses.name: signature
actionClasses.description: Sending a document for signature or applying a signature
examples: send a contract to its signers through a signature provider

actionClasses.name: legal-action
actionClasses.description: Any action with legal meaning outside signing
examples: send a notice with legal effect
register a claim or a takedown on behalf of the company

actionClasses.name: payment
actionClasses.description: Executing or authorizing a payment or payout

actionClasses.name: external-send-irreversible
actionClasses.description: Sending data to an external party in a way that cannot be recalled
examples: submit a package to a distributor

actionClasses.name: external-publish-irreversible
actionClasses.description: Publishing content publicly in a way that cannot be undone

actionClasses.name: auto-fix-legal-financial
actionClasses.description: Automatically correcting data whose change alters legal or financial meaning

actionClasses.name: bulk-data-change
actionClasses.description: Applying a change to many business records at once
examples: repair a set of orphan records
